<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask keybindings-docs`; do not edit. -->

`secondary` is Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere. Override any binding in the Keymap category of the Settings tab; overrides are the only thing written to `keymap.toml`.

## Vim list navigation preset

| Action | Keys | Context |
|---|---|---|
| `list_next` | `j` | List || Tree || Table |
| `list_prev` | `k` | List || Tree || Table |
| `list_first` | `g g` | List || Tree || Table |
| `list_last` | `shift-g` | List || Tree || Table |
| `list_collapse` | `h` | Tree |
| `list_expand` | `l` | Tree |
| `list_filter` | `/` | List || Tree || Table |
| `list_open` | `enter` | List || Tree || Table |
| `list_leave` | `escape` | List || Tree || Table |
